faqs.question: What is WhatsApp Business API in the United Kingdom?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API, also known as the WhatsApp Business Platform, helps growing businesses in the UK communicate with customers without managing every conversation manually. It supports bulk messaging, AI chatbots, CRM integrations, automated notifications, and customer support with multiple agents.
  • Businesses across London, Manchester, Birmingham, and the UK can use it for order updates, appointment reminders, marketing campaigns, and customer enquiries.
  • And you don't need to be a developer to get started. With MSG91, businesses can connect WhatsApp, launch campaigns, create chatbots, and manage customer conversations through a simple, no-code dashboard.

faqs.question: Why should UK businesses choose MSG91 as their WhatsApp Business Platform provider?
faqs.answer:
• Managing customer communication shouldn't require complicated software or technical expertise. MSG91 brings WhatsApp campaigns, AI chatbots, and customer support together in one easy-to-use platform.
  • UK businesses get a no-code dashboard to run campaigns, automate repetitive conversations, and manage customer enquiries as their operations grow.
  • And MSG91 goes beyond WhatsApp. With MSG91 One API, businesses can connect SMS, RCS, email, WhatsApp, and voice through one communication workflow, with configurable fallback when messages fail.
  • You also get MSG91 Hello, an AI-powered customer support platform with a shared inbox where teams can manage conversations together.
  • Trusted by 30,000+ businesses globally, MSG91 helps businesses simplify customer communication without juggling disconnected platforms.

faqs.question: What is the pricing of WhatsApp Business API in the UK?
faqs.answer:
• WhatsApp Business API pricing in the UK includes messaging charges and a platform subscription. MSG91 offers messaging rates approximately 10% lower than Meta's standard GBP pricing, helping businesses reduce communication costs.
  • MSG91's rates for UK numbers (+44), in GBP, are:
    • Marketing: £0.04134 per message
    • Utility: £0.01434 per message
    • Authentication: £0.01434 per message
    • Service: £0.01434 per billable message after the free allowance
  • The MSG91 Titan plan costs £6/month, with the first two months free. Messaging charges and applicable taxes are separate.
  • For example, sending 10,000 billable marketing messages costs £413.40 with MSG91 compared with £458 at Meta's standard rate, saving £44.60 before subscription fees and taxes.
  • Actual savings depend on messaging volume, applicable pricing tiers, and billing arrangements.
  • For a detailed breakdown, explore MSG91 WhatsApp Business API Pricing in the UK and Meta's WhatsApp Business Platform Pricing.

faqs.question: How can UK businesses reduce WhatsApp customer support costs after Meta's October 2026 pricing changes?
faqs.answer:
• Since October 1, 2026, Meta has charged for WhatsApp service messages beyond its monthly free allowance. The first 1,000 service messages per business phone number remain free each month, while additional messages are chargeable.
  • Utility templates sent within an active customer service window also became chargeable, subject to applicable exceptions.
  • For UK retailers, estate agencies, and service businesses answering hundreds of customer enquiries every day, these costs can add up.
  • MSG91 Chat Window offers a simpler way to continue conversations: WhatsApp → Chat Window → Hello.
  • Customers start on WhatsApp and open a dedicated Chat Window through a link. AI chatbots and human agents can then continue helping them through Hello without sending every reply over WhatsApp.
  • Messages exchanged inside Chat Window don't incur Meta's WhatsApp messaging charges. Messages sent through WhatsApp remain chargeable.
  • Follow the MSG91 Chat Window setup guide to learn more.

faqs.question: Can UK businesses send WhatsApp OTPs, use WhatsApp Flows, and configure fallback channels?
faqs.answer:
• Yes. MSG91 enables UK businesses to send WhatsApp OTPs for account verification, secure logins, and other eligible authentication requirements.
  • With MSG91 OTP Widget, businesses can configure resend options and supported verification alternatives through SMS, voice calls, and email if the first code is not received.
  • WhatsApp Flows allow customers to complete interactive tasks directly within WhatsApp. These include appointment bookings, lead forms, event registrations, customer feedback, and other guided processes.
  • For example, a private clinic can collect appointment requests through a Flow, while an estate agency can gather property-viewing preferences without sending customers to a separate form.
  • For important service notifications, MSG91 supports configurations that use SMS, RCS, email, or voice as fallback options when WhatsApp delivery fails.
  • Businesses should apply suitable consent, privacy, and security controls to these workflows. Channel-specific charges may apply.
  • Explore the OTP Widget integration guide.

faqs.question: Which industries in the UK benefit most from WhatsApp Business API?
faqs.answer:

  • Some relevant industries in the UK include:
    • E-commerce and Retail: Recover abandoned carts, send order updates, handle returns, and automate seasonal campaigns.
    • Estate Agencies: Qualify property enquiries, arrange viewings, and follow up with potential buyers and tenants.
    • Healthcare and Private Clinics: Manage appointment reminders, scheduling enquiries, and routine administrative support.
    • Financial Services and Fintech: Send OTPs, payment notifications, and account updates.
    • Travel and Hospitality: Handle hotel reservations, booking confirmations, and guest enquiries.
    • Logistics and Delivery: Share shipment updates, delivery notifications, and scheduling information.
  • For Shopify retailers, MSG91's Shopify integration supports automation across the shopping journey. Businesses can use AI chatbots, multichannel verification through WhatsApp, SMS, email, and voice, COD-to-prepaid conversion workflows where applicable, and automated notifications for order confirmation, tracking, and 12+ supported Shopify events.
  • For example, a UK fashion store can automatically confirm purchases, share delivery updates, and use an AI chatbot to resolve common customer questions.
  • With MSG91 Hello, support teams can view conversations together and transfer enquiries to human agents whenever necessary.

faqs.question: How can UK businesses set up WhatsApp Business API and get support from MSG91?
faqs.answer:
• Getting started with WhatsApp automation shouldn't require coding skills or a technical team. MSG91 makes WhatsApp Cloud API setup simple, even for business owners and teams without development experience.
  • From a user-friendly dashboard, you can connect your WhatsApp number, create campaigns, configure supported chatbots, and manage customer conversations without writing code.
  • Get started in four simple steps:
    • 1: Create your MSG91 account.
    • 2: Connect your Meta Business Portfolio.
    • 3: Add an eligible UK WhatsApp number (+44).
    • 4: Complete verification and configure your messages.
  • That's it! Once connected, you can create approved templates, launch campaigns, and manage conversations directly from the dashboard.
  • Advanced custom integrations may require technical configuration, and additional Meta verification can affect activation time.
  • Do I need Companies House registration, and can I keep my +44 number? Companies House details may be requested during additional Meta business verification, but aren't mandatory for every initial setup. Documentation requirements may differ for sole traders.
  • Already using WhatsApp Business? You may be able to migrate an eligible +44 number to MSG91. However, WhatsApp Coexistence isn't currently supported for UK numbers, so simultaneous use of the Business App and API on the same number isn't available through that feature.
  • Need help? MSG91 offers 24/7 customer assistance, combining expert human support through email, WhatsApp, calls, and scheduled Google Meet sessions with round-the-clock AI that handles routine questions and complex technical enquiries.
  • With MSG91 Hello, you can also provide your customers with AI-powered conversations, a shared inbox, and seamless handover to human agents.
  • From your first WhatsApp setup to everyday customer communication, MSG91 makes automation easier to manage.
  • Explore the WhatsApp onboarding guide or contact MSG91 support.
